title: Payments
description: Key payment metrics: volume, success rate, fees, refunds, disputes, payouts, fiscal documents, Stripe webhooks and reconciliation, financial backlogs and provider health.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: Deployment environment. Workload selectors are built from it as <env>-ns, <env>-api and so on, matching baseConfig.environment in only-chance-devops. Add prod here when it exists. SQL panels follow the Postgres datasource below, not this variable.

list.name: postgres
list.label: Postgres
list.description: Application database for the selected environment. Add one datasource per environment when prod exists.

panels.title: Gross volume
panels.description: Charged amount of payments that succeeded (including later refunds), by payment creation time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS "Gross volume"
FROM payments WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'refunded') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Successful payments
panels.description: Payments that reached succeeded, including ones refunded afterwards.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Successful payments"
FROM payments WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'refunded') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Succeeded ÷ (succeeded + failed). Cancelled checkouts are excluded because the fan never paid.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'refunded'))::float
       / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'refunded', 'failed')), 0), 1) AS "Success rate"
FROM payments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Platform fees
panels.description: Platform commission kept, net of commission returned on refunds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(platform_fee_cents - coalesce(refunded_platform_fee_cents, 0)), 0) / 100.0 AS "Platform fees"
FROM payments WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'refunded') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Stripe fees
panels.description: Stripe processing fees recorded from the charge's balance transaction.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(stripe_fee_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS "Stripe fees"
FROM payments WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'refunded') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Refunded
panels.description: Succeeded Stripe refunds created in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS "Refunded"
FROM stripe_refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Open disputes
panels.description: Disputes Stripe has not closed yet, regardless of the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Open disputes"
FROM stripe_disputes WHERE provider_status NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'warning_closed', 'prevented')

panels.title: Financial backlog
panels.description: Rows needing operator attention across reconciliation, fiscal review, refund recovery and disputes (financial-health collector).

panels.title: Payments by outcome
panels.description: Payments created per interval by current status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM payments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gross volume and platform fees
panels.description: Money in per interval for succeeded payments.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0),
       sum(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS "Gross volume",
       sum(platform_fee_cents - coalesce(refunded_platform_fee_cents, 0)) / 100.0 AS "Platform fees",
       sum(coalesce(stripe_fee_cents, 0)) / 100.0 AS "Stripe fees"
FROM payments WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'refunded') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Checkout funnel
panels.description: Seat reservations started per interval: confirmed became a booking, expired timed out before payment, cancelled were released by the fan.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM booking_reservations WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Payments needing attention
panels.description: Current state, independent of the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS "Check", n AS "Count", oldest AS "Oldest" FROM (
  SELECT 'Finalization pending > 15 min' AS label, count(*) AS n, min(created_at) AS oldest
    FROM payments WHERE finalization_status = 'pending' AND status = 'succeeded' AND created_at < now() - interval '15 minutes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Flagged for financial review', count(*), min(created_at) FROM payments WHERE requires_financial_review
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Failed in the last 24 h', count(*), min(created_at)
    FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Refund recovery not settled', count(*), min(refund_recovery_updated_at)
    FROM payments WHERE refund_recovery_status IS NOT NULL AND refund_recovery_status NOT IN ('not_required', 'succeeded')
) s ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Refunds
panels.description: Stripe refund amounts per interval by status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), status AS metric, sum(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS value
FROM stripe_refunds WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Booking refunds by status
panels.description: Refunds the platform initiated for cancelled bookings, current state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Refunds", sum(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS "Amount",
       max(attempt_count) AS "Max attempts", min(created_at) AS "Oldest"
FROM booking_refunds GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Disputes
panels.description: All disputes by Stripe status and host recovery progress.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT provider_status AS "Stripe status", coalesce(recovery_status, '-') AS "Host recovery", count(*) AS "Disputes",
       sum(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS "Amount", min(evidence_due_at) FILTER (WHERE evidence_due_at > now()) AS "Next evidence due"
FROM stripe_disputes GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Host payouts
panels.description: Host payouts by status, current state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Payouts", sum(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS "Amount",
       min(created_at) AS "Oldest"
FROM payouts GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Payout releases
panels.description: Payout release gate state: held releases wait for their release time or a gate (dispute window, host tier).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status", coalesce(tier, '-') AS "Tier", count(*) AS "Releases",
       min(release_not_before) FILTER (WHERE release_not_before > now()) AS "Next release"
FROM payout_releases GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Connected accounts
panels.description: Host Stripe Connect accounts and their capability state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS "Accounts", n AS "Count" FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS o, 'Connected' AS label, count(*) AS n FROM payment_profiles WHERE stripe_account_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Charges enabled', count(*) FROM payment_profiles WHERE stripe_charges_enabled
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Payouts enabled', count(*) FROM payment_profiles WHERE stripe_payouts_enabled
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Requirements past due', count(*) FROM payment_profiles
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(stripe_requirements_past_due) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(stripe_requirements_past_due) > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Disabled by Stripe', count(*) FROM payment_profiles WHERE stripe_disabled_reason IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Last payout failed', count(*) FROM payment_profiles WHERE stripe_payout_failure_code IS NOT NULL
) s ORDER BY o

panels.title: Fiscal documents
panels.description: Commission invoices and credit notes by state and blocking reason, current state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind AS "Kind", status AS "Status", coalesce(reason, '-') AS "Reason", count(*) AS "Documents",
       sum(fee_cents) / 100.0 AS "Commission", min(created_at) AS "Oldest"
FROM fiscal_documents GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Fiscal documents issued
panels.description: Documents reaching issued per interval (by last update).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(updated_at, $__interval, 0), kind AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM fiscal_documents WHERE status = 'issued' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fiscal contacts
panels.description: Host contact provisioning at Elorus. Contacts in review block every invoice of that host.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status", coalesce(reason, '-') AS "Reason", count(*) AS "Contacts"
FROM fiscal_contact_provisions GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Webhook events
panels.description: Stripe webhook events received per interval by processing status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM stripe_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Webhook events not processed
panels.description: Every webhook event that is not processed yet, any age.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_type AS "Event", status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Events", max(attempt_count) AS "Max attempts",
       min(created_at) AS "Oldest", min(next_retry_at) AS "Next retry"
FROM stripe_events WHERE status <> 'processed' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Reconciliation runs
panels.description: Nightly Stripe balance reconciliation, latest ten dates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT reconciliation_date AS "Date", status AS "Status", discrepancy_count AS "Discrepancies",
       completed_at AS "Completed"
FROM stripe_reconciliation_runs ORDER BY reconciliation_date DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Financial backlog
panels.description: Durable rows waiting for operator attention, by queue.

panels.title: Oldest backlog item
panels.description: Age of the oldest row per queue.

panels.title: Health collector last ran
panels.description: Seconds since the financial-health collector last pushed. Backlog panels are stale if this grows.

panels.title: Payment jobs behind
panels.description: Payment CronJobs whose latest scheduled run has not succeeded within 15 minutes. Details on the Jobs and backups dashboard.

targets.expr: count((max by (cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_schedule_time{namespace="${env}-ns", cronjob=~"${env}-api-(refund-dispatch|invoicing-dispatch|stripe-webhook-dispatch|stripe-reconciliation|financial-health|reservation-expiry|connect-account-sync)"}) - max by (cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace="${env}-ns", cronjob=~"${env}-api-(refund-dispatch|invoicing-dispatch|stripe-webhook-dispatch|stripe-reconciliation|financial-health|reservation-expiry|connect-account-sync)"})) > 900) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stripe calls failing
panels.description: Failed Stripe API calls in the selected range, from the API and the payment jobs.

targets.expr: sum(increase(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count{dependency="stripe", outcome="error", job="only-chance-api"}[$__range]) or max_over_time(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count{dependency="stripe", outcome="error", job!="only-chance-api"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Elorus calls failing
panels.description: Failed Elorus API calls in the selected range (a 404 during the demo reset counts here).

targets.expr: sum(increase(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count{dependency="elorus", outcome="error", job="only-chance-api"}[$__range]) or max_over_time(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count{dependency="elorus", outcome="error", job!="only-chance-api"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stripe and Elorus calls
panels.description: Provider calls per interval from the API and the payment jobs, on a log scale so the nightly reconciliation burst does not hide routine traffic. Job runs push their own counters, so they are summed per run rather than as a rate.

targets.expr: sum by (dependency, outcome) (increase(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count{dependency=~"stripe|elorus", job="only-chance-api"}[$__interval]) or max_over_time(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count{dependency=~"stripe|elorus", job!="only-chance-api"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Provider latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile call time to Stripe and Elorus per interval, across the API and the payment jobs.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (dependency, le) (increase(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_bucket{dependency=~"stripe|elorus", job="only-chance-api"}[$__interval]) or max_over_time(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_bucket{dependency=~"stripe|elorus", job!="only-chance-api"}[$__interval])))
